notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
Main Menu soft lock fixed
New level up aura effect added
Difficulty adjustments
Small quality of life fixes....

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
Update 2 changes/fixes

-Shorten Healer Offensive Special time
-Added new menu UI
-Added new Pause and Shop UI
-Fixed crash when player leaves HowToPlay Character Select
-Fixed Wave mode trigger after 4th boss
-Fixed door UI to detect whether the player is on keyboard or Gamepad
- New Rogue Mode levels
- Spawners now spawn when attacked
- Fire and Ice boss damage hitboxes adjusted
-Fixed Ice boss underling soft lock not waking.
-Added larger Melee, Defensive, Offensive cooldown Icons
- Other small patches and fixes.

notes.title: version 1.05
notes.notes:
Gamepad support added. 
Player can play with keyboard & Mouse or Gamepad throughout gameplay. Other tweaks to gameplay and levels. More Updates to come!

notes.title: small patches and Rogue mode
notes.notes: Added more levels to Rogue mode and fixed lvl up notification bug

notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes: All Achievements are in and should fire. Some small other fixes to projectiles and some text

notes.title: Death' Dungeon Release
notes.notes: Death's Dungeon is now available on steam. It will receive several updates in the coming months. In the form of patches, content, etc.
